ghas_title: 4 new alerts including 2 high severity security vulnerabilities

alerts.title: Clear text storage of sensitive information
alerts.reason: Nest JWT access token is intentionally stored in HttpOnly Secure(SameSite=lax) cookie — session authority (ADR-006). Not clear-text log or DB store of raw secrets.
alerts.dismissal_reason: Won't fix — design-accepted session cookie storage

alerts.title: Clear text storage of sensitive information
alerts.reason: Admin double-submit CSRF cookie must be JS-readable (httpOnly=false). Session cookie remains HttpOnly. CSRF compared via timingSafeEqual — not a session secret.
alerts.dismissal_reason: False positive — intentional CSRF double-submit cookie

alerts.title: File data in outbound network request
alerts.reason: Live fetch now uses hardcoded STAGING_WEB_ORIGIN / STAGING_OPS_ORIGIN constants; fixture values are equality-gated only.

alerts.title: File data in outbound network request
alerts.reason: Live fetch URL built from STAGING_WEB_ORIGIN constant + path-only scenario.path; fixture stagingWeb equality-gated.
